primary.poolable_reason: THE TWO TRIALS DO NOT SHARE ONE ENDPOINT, AND ONE WHOLE COMPONENT IS PRESENT IN ONE AND ABSENT FROM THE OTHER. FOURIER's primary, verbatim from its registry record, is 'Time to Cardiovascular Death, Myocardial Infarction, Hospitalization for Unstable Angina, Stroke, or CORONARY REVASCULARIZATION'. ODYSSEY OUTCOMES' primary is a MACE composite its record defines as 'Coronary Heart Disease (CHD) death, non-fatal Myocardial Infarction (MI), fatal and non-fatal ischemic stroke (IS), or unstable angina (UA) requiring hospitalization' -- WITH NO REVASCULARIZATION COMPONENT AT ALL. Coronary revascularization is the most frequent component of FOURIER's composite, so this is not a wording difference: one trial counts a class of event the other does not count. THREE FURTHER DIFFERENCES, each on the face of the records: FOURIER counts CARDIOVASCULAR death while ODYSSEY counts CORONARY HEART DISEASE death, which is a subset of it; FOURIER counts STROKE of any type while ODYSSEY counts ISCHAEMIC stroke only; FOURIER counts MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION while ODYSSEY counts NON-FATAL myocardial infarction only. SEPARATELY AND SUFFICIENT ON ITS OWN: every per-trial value in this object was an ODDS RATIO DERIVED BY US from 2x2 counts, while both trials analyse time to first occurrence by Kaplan-Meier and report hazard ratios.

pooled.withdrawn_note: AND A THIRD DEFECT, ON THE INDEX RATHER THAN IN THE POOL. The card and the table row published 'HR 0.85 (0.79-0.92), k=2'. THIS OBJECT'S POOLED VALUE IS OR 0.8440 (0.7952 to 0.8958). The number on the index was never the number in the object -- it is a single trial's own reported hazard ratio, presented as a two-trial pooled result and labelled with a measure this review never computed. ARM LABELS ARE INVERTED ON BOTH TRIALS AND THAT IS NOT RESOLVED HERE. The arm carrying the role INTERVENTION is labelled 'Placebo' on FOURIER and 'Placebo' on ODYSSEY OUTCOMES, while the arms labelled 'Evolocumab' and 'Alirocumab 75 mg Q2W' carry the role CONTROL. An arm cannot be both the placebo and the intervention, so the object is self-contradictory on its face. WHICH HALF IS WRONG -- the label or the role -- needs each trial's own arm sizes and event counts from source, and is left open rather than guessed: the pooled estimate can be right in magnitude while every label a reader sees is on the wrong arm, which is exactly how EAST-AFNET 4's swapped arms survived on ABLATION_AF. The same inversion is present on six other trials across four objects and comes from the converter, not from this page. WHAT IS CONFIRMED: both trials are PCSK9 inhibitors against placebo in atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, both adjudicated centrally and blind, both analysed as time to first event. The question this review asks is a real one and these are the right two trials for it. What cannot stand is averaging two composites when one of them counts revascularization and the other does not.
previous_values: index card and table row: HR 0.85 (0.79-0.92), k=2 -- a value that appears nowhere in this object
pooled.card_note: FOURIER’s primary composite counts CORONARY REVASCULARIZATION and ODYSSEY OUTCOMES’ does not; FOURIER counts cardiovascular death, any stroke and any MI where ODYSSEY counts coronary-heart-disease death, ischaemic stroke and non-fatal MI only. Both stated on their own registry records. The withdrawn HR 0.85 (0.79–0.92) was a single trial’s result shown as a two-trial pool; this review’s own pooled value was OR 0.8440

primary.poolable_DEPRECATED_note: `poolable` MEANT ONLY 'the source page pooled these trials'. It was never a judgement that the pool was sound, and the renderer read it as permission to assert 'pooled on the X scale'. RENAMED to source_page_pooled, which is what it says. `poolable` is retained so nothing breaks, and it is DEPRECATED: read source_page_pooled for what the source did, and estimand_established for whether the pool is defensible. A PAGE SHOULD DISPLAY A POOLED ESTIMATE BECAUSE ITS ESTIMAND WAS ESTABLISHED, NOT BECAUSE SOMEONE ONCE POOLED IT.
primary.estimand_established_means: TRUE only where every contributing trial has been READ and shown to measure the same quantity, or the same construct with a variance stated. FALSE where that was checked and failed. NULL where it was never checked -- AN ABSENT ASSERTION AND A NEGATIVE ONE ARE DIFFERENT STATES and null is not a pass.
